verdict.rationale: INPI offers online filing for trademarks, designs, patents and e-Soleau, so whether it publishes operating hours, per-day limits or session timeouts is a fair question. None of the filing documentation titles mention service windows, daily caps or session timeouts being disclosed before a filing starts. The data.inpi.fr 403 probe concerns open-data API access, not the filing flow, so it is not relevant here.
